warehouse.question: What are gross sales so far this month?
warehouse.answer: Gross sales so far this month (November 1 to 12:40 CST today) are $2.52M. This is before discounts and returns, and it excludes cancelled orders.

baseline.answer: Gross sales so far this month (1–17 November 2026, up to now) are $2.42M, before discounts, across 6,265 order lines. This excludes QA test orders and cancelled or returned orders.

warehouse.question: Month to date, what is our gross sales figure?
warehouse.answer: Month-to-date gross sales for November 2026 (1 to 17 November, up to 12:40 CST) is $2.52M. This is the value of all non-cancelled orders before discounts and returns are taken out. The data is current as of 12:39 CST.

baseline.answer: Month-to-date gross sales are $2.42M (1–17 November 2026, through 12:40 CST), from 6,265 order lines. This is quantity × unit price before discounts, excluding test orders and cancelled or returned orders.

warehouse.question: What was the cancellation rate over the last 7 full days, not counting today?
warehouse.answer: The cancellation rate over the last 7 complete days (10 to 16 November, today excluded) was 4.8%. This is cancelled orders as a share of all orders placed.

baseline.answer: The cancellation rate was 5.03% for Monday 9 November through Sunday 15 November 2026 (the last 7 full days, excluding today and QA test orders). That is 149 cancelled order lines out of 2,963.

warehouse.question: What was the return rate last month?
warehouse.answer: The return rate for October 2026 (the whole of last month) was 4.4%. This is returned orders as a share of fulfilled orders (completed plus returned), with cancelled orders excluded from both sides.

baseline.answer: Last month's return rate was **4.2%** of order lines: 551 of 13,220 non-test orders placed in October 2026 (America/Chicago time) came back as returned. Measured by cases, it was 4.6% (18,102 of 389,322 cases). Both include cancelled orders in the denominator, and test orders are excluded.

warehouse.question: What percentage of orders came back as returns last month?
warehouse.answer: The return rate for October 2026 was 4.4%. This is returned orders as a share of fulfilled orders (completed plus returned), with cancelled orders left out of both sides.

baseline.answer: About 4.17% of orders were returned in October 2026 (551 of 13,220 orders). I counted all non-test orders placed from 1 to 31 October in Chicago time, including cancelled ones in the denominator.

warehouse.question: Did we produce more or fewer cases last week than the week before, and by how much in percent?
warehouse.answer: We produced fewer cases last week. Production was 936,117 cases for Monday 9 to Sunday 15 November, down 10,976 cases (-1.2%) from 947,093 the week before (2 to 8 November). This counts all cases produced, including those later scrapped.

baseline.answer: We produced fewer cases last week: 929,795 cases (Mon 9 to Sun 15 Nov) versus 950,345 the week before (Mon 2 to Sun 8 Nov), down about 2.2%, or 20,550 cases. Figures include all production runs, scrapped cases included.
